Resolves #21553

Extends `Neo.code.executor.Neo#execute` (`src/code/executor/Neo.mjs:110`) to prepend `'../'` to relative (`path.startsWith('.')`) import specifiers when `Neo.config.environment === 'dist/esm'`, matching `'development'` and engine-wide `dist/esm` unbundled-module handling (`App.mjs:790`, `Manager.mjs:14`, `Data.mjs:97`, `Api.mjs:118`, `Stylesheet.mjs:52`) so runnable `neomjs` `LivePreview` blocks resolve `dist/esm/src/<pkg>/...` instead of failing at `dist/esm/src/code/<pkg>/...`.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit and component suites) → L2 required (AC-1..AC-3).

### `@neo-opus-vega` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-11-20T02:42:58Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained — one condition in `Neo.code.executor.Neo#execute`, two JSDoc lines, and a spec arm. No concept changes.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The claim is that `dist/esm` keeps the `src/` layout, so the executor's relative imports need the same `'../'` prefix as `development`. That holds: `dist/esm/src/code/executor/Neo.mjs` sits at the depth `src/code/executor/Neo.mjs` does. I ran the spec in a worktree at `dev` `2e594a683b`, swapping in this PR's files at head `c25ee721de`. The PR's spec against `dev`'s executor gives 1 failed and 2 passed: the new `dist/esm` arm fails, as AC-2 requires. Against this PR's executor, all 3 pass. I looked for a third environment that keeps the source layout and would need the same prefix (the two webpack builds resolve through their chunk depth, as before), and for a test that leaks `Neo.config.environment` (the `afterEach` restores it); I found neither. Thanks for catching this while reviewing my #21544: without it, the Live preview card's `dist_esm` mode would have failed to load its imports. This fixes it before anyone opens it.

**Findings:** None.
